p: shut: Meaning, from the common people, but not from the priests nor the prince, read Eze 46:8,9.
strangers: For they had brought idolaters who were from other countries, to teach them their idolatry, Eze 23:40.
charge of my holy things: You have not offered to me according to my Law.

Levites that have gone away far: The Levites who had committed idolatry were put from their dignity and could not be received into the priests office although they had been of the house of Aaron, but must serve in the inferior offices as to watch and to keep the doors, read 2Ki 23:9.
kept the charge of my sanctuary: Who observed the law of God and did not fall to idolatry.
shave their heads: As did the infidels and heathen.
defile themselves: They may be at their burial which was a defiling.
